title: Room Reservations Booking Conditions: Deposit Ceiling for Long and Early-Booked Resort Stays
content:
**Condition.** Where the deposit a Room Reservations resort reservation requires is worked out again after a change raises its nightly rate, the deposit is capped by a share of the whole stay. For a stay of at least 6 nights booked at least 120 days before arrival, the deposit is the lesser of the deposit by nights and the advance-booking share, 25%, of the whole stay's room and tax; for a stay of at least 10 nights booked fewer than 120 days before arrival, it is the lesser of the deposit by nights and the long-stay share, 20%, of the whole stay's room and tax; any other stay pays the deposit by nights.

**Terms.**

- *Deposit by nights* — the nights the deposit covers multiplied by the nightly rate on the reservation, with room tax added at the hotel's tax rate.
- *Whole stay's room and tax* — every night of the stay at the nightly rate on the reservation, with room tax added at the hotel's tax rate.
- *Stay* — the nights from the arrival date to the departure date.
- *Booked before arrival* — the calendar days from the booked date to the arrival date.

## Which ceiling applies

| Stay | Booked 120 days or more before arrival | Booked fewer than 120 days before arrival |
|---|---|---|
| 10 nights or more | lesser of the deposit by nights and 25% of the whole stay | lesser of the deposit by nights and 20% of the whole stay |
| 6 to 9 nights | lesser of the deposit by nights and 25% of the whole stay | deposit by nights |
| 5 nights or fewer | deposit by nights | deposit by nights |

## Cases (hypothetical nightly rate of 300.00, tax 10%)

| Stay | Booked before arrival | Deposit by nights | Share of the whole stay | Deposit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6 nights | 150 days | 660.00 | 25% of 1,980.00: 495.00 | 495.00 |
| 6 nights | 119 days | 660.00 | — | 660.00 |
| 12 nights | 60 days | 660.00 | 20% of 3,960.00: 792.00 | 660.00 |
| 4 nights | 200 days | 660.00 | — | 660.00 |

The ceiling only ever lowers the deposit: where the deposit by nights is already the lesser figure, it stands.
